options.label: A
options.textMd: A chloride ion loses an electron to form a neutral chlorine atom.

options.label: B
options.textMd: A sodium atom becomes Na⁺ by electron loss.

options.label: C
options.textMd: An iron(III) ion gains an electron to become iron(II).

options.label: D
options.textMd: A magnesium atom loses two electrons.

options.label: E
options.textMd: An element’s oxidation number rises from +2 to +4.

explanationMd: Reduction is gain of electrons and a decrease in oxidation number. Fe³⁺ + e⁻ → Fe²⁺ satisfies both tests. The other changes involve electron loss or an increasing oxidation number, so they represent oxidation.

distractorRationale.e: An increase in oxidation number is oxidation.
